hubTrigger.claim: August 2017 RMB appreciation was about 1.69%, turning FX into a potentially material earnings driver for USD-liability companies.

causalNeighborhood: Map the currency move into companies with large USD-denominated liabilities and RMB reporting, then distinguish a real earnings bridge from a new profit pool. FX remeasurement is a known macro transfer, not an emerging business line.

candidates.name: 中国国航

companyEvidence.claim: H1 revenue RMB58.15bn +8.65%; finance expense fell sharply, with RMB1.27bn FX gain versus RMB1.698bn FX loss in prior year.
At 2017-06-30, a 1% RMB appreciation versus USD would increase net profit/equity by about RMB290.6m.

expectationEvidence.claim: Sell-side explicitly quantified each 1% RMB appreciation as roughly RMB291m/RMB322m/RMB265m profit benefit for Air China/China Eastern/China Southern and expected Q3 airline profit acceleration; Air China was the preferred A-share.

risks: fuel-price inflation can offset FX gains
underlying operating profit remained sensitive to yield and fuel

candidates.name: 中国东航
evidence: 2017H1 produced RMB674m FX gain versus RMB1.355bn prior-year FX loss; headline net profit +34.46% included material disposal gain.
candidates.risk: profit quality complicated by disposal of Eastern Air Logistics

candidates.name: 南方航空
evidence: 2017H1 finance expense fell 69.61%; RMB561m FX gain versus RMB1.506bn prior-year loss, while attributable profit still fell 11.62% because fuel costs surged.
candidates.risk: fuel inflation visibly offset currency benefit

nextGate: freeze 20/60/120d price absorption at 2017-09-15; likely No selection if benefit is already priced or if fuel/yield uncertainty dominates.
